observations: body L1: «بغَيْر» has no vowel sign under the bāʾ or the rāʾ; «واحتجّوا» has the shadda alone.
body L4: «الكَبِيرِ» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed; its kasra stands under the tail of the rāʾ, 6.0 points below the baseline.
body L5: the singular «فَرْدٌ» is printed in square brackets.

body L9: a kasra-shaped stroke (3.0 by 2.3 points) is printed under the fāʾ of «فَرَسٌ», which has its fatḥa; not transcribed. The fatḥa over the fāʾ of «الفَارِسُ» is printed short (1.6 points). «المُمْسِك», «لرَأْس» and «الغُول» have no vowel sign on their last letters.

body L11: «٢٩{20}» is a 2 joined to a 9 (5.8 points, no crest between the stem and the 9); «٣١» has a 3 with two crests and a 1 (6.2 points); the figure after «٣٧» is a 9 with a closed bowl. The i after «فَرَضَ» is the lowercase letter.
body L13, L22, L26: «85-86» and «٢١-٢٢» are printed with hyphens (3.3-3.6 points), «١٨١–١٨٨» with an en dash (5.4 points).
body L14, L15: «iuxtá» (L14) is printed with an acute over the a (2.0 by 1.8 points); «iuxta» in L15 has none. Transcribed as printed.
body L18: «فريجيون» has two dots under its first tooth, a jīm, and two dots under its second tooth, as «فريجيون» on p. 322.
body L23, L35: «الكُرَة» has no vowel sign on the tāʾ marbūṭa, «المُسْتَقِيم» none on its final mīm.
body L24: the L of «Lunae» is printed broken.
body L28: the iota subscript of «ζωδίων» is not printed; transcribed as printed.
body L33: the first word is «من»: its mīm has the closed loop of «من» in L23.
body L39: «الفلك المُمَثَّلُ (لفلك البروج)» stands left of «v.» and «ممثّل» right of it; the order is fixed from the x positions of the five runs.
body L7, L25: a speck (1.2 points) is printed at mid-height before «numeratae» (L7), and one under the second c of «concentricas» (L25); not transcribed.
body L33, L37, L38: the print is heavier to the right of x 497 (the «ali» of «aequinoctiali», «ἔκκεντρος» in L37, «occurrens»); the type is the same, transcribed in the ordinary type.

body L9, L10, L27-L31, L33, L35, L37, L38, L40: the article ὁ and «ὁμαλῆς» have the rough breathing (the δ-shaped sort with the head to the right), «ὀρϑὴ» the smooth one; «οἱ» and «ἡ» have the rough breathing; the ε of «ἐπίκυκλος», «ἐπίκυκλον», «ἐφ’», «ἐπι-» and «ἐγκεκλιμένος» has the smooth one.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
